question: I received a wrong item on my Instamart order.
answer: We're sorry about the mismatch in your order. Please share an image of the item you received so we can check and help you accordingly.

question: I didn’t receive an item in my Instamart order.
answer: Please share an image of the items you received. Our team will verify and assist you with the missing item.

question: I received a spoiled / damaged / expired / leaking item.
answer: We apologize for the inconvenience. Please share an image of the item along with its packaging so we can help you better.

question: I received an item with incorrect quantity.
answer: Please share an image of the item with the quantity mismatch clearly visible. We will look into it immediately.

question: I have not received my refund.
answer: Refunds are usually processed within 5–7 business days depending on your bank. If it has been longer, please let us know your order ID and payment method.

question: How can I track my refund status?
answer: Refunds are automatically processed to your original payment method. You can check the ‘Help’ section under your Instamart order for more details.

question: My Instamart order is delayed.
answer: We understand delays can be frustrating. Delivery time can vary due to high demand or operational issues. You can track the latest status in the app.

question: Why was my Instamart order cancelled?
answer: Orders may be cancelled due to stock unavailability, operational issues, or if the delivery partner couldn't reach your location. Any charged amount will be refunded.

question: My payment failed but the amount was deducted.
answer: In rare cases, failed payments may still result in temporary deductions. These are usually reversed by your bank within 2–5 business days.

question: Why am I unable to select a delivery slot?
answer: Delivery slots may be temporarily unavailable due to high demand. Please try again after some time.

question: Instamart is not available in my area.
answer: Instamart availability depends on your pincode. We are expanding rapidly, so please check back later as your area may be added soon.
